judge.rationale: The core validation implementation in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` works as required, compiling static schemas at registration time, caching dynamic schemas with a `WeakMap`, and returning a `ToolResponse` on validation failure without leaking values. However, the candidate appears to have stopped mid-task (as indicated by the unchecked facet in its own `.lore/dod.md`, which was also left in the diff). It completely missed the required documentation updates in `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`, and only wrote a stub entry in `CHANGELOG.md`. Several explicit test acceptance criteria are also missing from `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, including tests for extra properties passing through unchanged, dynamic schema changes across calls, and unregistered tool throws. Finally, it added `ajv` v6 instead of v8 and logged `inputKeys` instead of the failing property paths on validation failure.
